entry.summary:
From [Yen Press](http://www.yenpress.com/book-girl-novel/):  
For Tohko Amano, a third-year high-school student and self-styled “book girl,” being the head of the literary club is more than just an extracurricular activity. It’s her bread and butter…literally! Tohko is actually a literature-gobbling demon, who can be found at all hours of the day munching on torn-out pages from all kinds of books. But for Tohko, the real delicacies are hand-written stories. To satisfy her gourmet tastes, she’s employed (rather, browbeaten) one Konoha Inoue, who scribbles away each day after school to satisfy Tohko’s appetite. But when another student comes knocking on the literary club door for advice on writing love letters, will Tohko discover a new kind of delicacy?

The stress from the novel's fame and its movie and television drama plans turned Inoue into an introverted recluse.

entry.title: "Duo Duo Suo Suo" Tao Li Ni
entry.summary:
The ultimate showdown between I-person and E-person. 

Trendy toy designer Ai Xu was a socially anxious child, averse to socializing and collaboration. As an adult, she managed to find a job where she was 90% responsible for her own work, becoming an original IP designer. However, the only drawback was the weekly meetings where she had to speak. Fortunately, she could manage it with a PowerPoint presentation, but today, she was asked to partner with the dazzling, super-e-person Zhiyi from the marketing department to pilot a project. 

Their extreme personality clashes created countless dramas, bringing a series of surprises and twists to Ai Xu's peaceful life. Beyond their personal connection, their differing work styles, perspectives, and approaches to work clashed repeatedly. Overcoming setbacks, they reconciled themselves, understood each other's approaches, and worked together to transform a soon-to-be-discontinued original IP into a premier super IP. This is where their clash and brilliance begin.

During an info session at one of the companies, she accidentally gets hurt but receives help from the company’s information desk clerk, Osamu.
